seo.title: Product - Northwind Notes
seo.description: Write, link and export: how Northwind Notes works.

seo.title: About - Northwind Notes
seo.description: Northwind Notes is a made-up product that gives FormPublisher a sample site.

a1-p-3df0ba.name: Answer 1 text
a1-p-3df0ba.text: In a folder you choose, one plain text file for each note. There is no database and no account.

a2-p-3df0ba.name: Answer 2 text
a2-p-3df0ba.text: Yes. Any editor that opens text files can open your notes, and Northwind Notes picks up the changes at once.

a3-p-3df0ba.name: Answer 3 text
a3-p-3df0ba.text: It never needs a network. The sample site you are reading is a static export and needs none either.

a4-p-3df0ba.name: Answer 4 text
a4-p-3df0ba.text: Copy the folder. Export also writes a single archive with every note and its links.

about-p1.name: Text
about-p1.text: Northwind Notes does not exist. This three page site was built in FormWeb to give FormPublisher something real to open, check, package and prepare for six hosts.

about-p2.name: Text
about-p2.text: It has a redirect from an old address, a page for addresses that do not exist and pictures that were drawn for it, so every check has something to look at.

d1-7ee392.name: Description
d1-7ee392.text: Press N and start typing. Each note is saved as you go, as a plain text file in your notebook folder.

d2-7ee392.name: Description
d2-7ee392.text: Type two square brackets to link to another note. Links show up on both notes, so you can walk the trail either way.

d3-7ee392.name: Description
d3-7ee392.text: Press Export to write every note and its links to a folder or one archive. It takes seconds, even for a big notebook.
